source.authority: official SPT modding wiki quest-values reference
source.documentedSemantics: Kills.resetOnSessionEnd=true resets incomplete kill progress at session end (exfil/death), requiring that bounded kill quota to be completed within one raid. CounterCreator.oneSessionOnly is documented as currently unused and must not be treated as a supported coupling primitive.

singleRaidKillQuota.meaning: A bounded Kills counter can require its kill quota to be completed within one raid because incomplete progress resets at raid/session end.
singleRaidKillQuota.safeUse: May constrain a pure combat objective to one raid after its target/location/weapon filters are otherwise proven.

oneSessionOnly.reason: Official SPT reference documents CounterCreator.oneSessionOnly as currently unused.

killThenExtractSameRaidCoupling.reason: resetOnSessionEnd proves only reset semantics for the Kills subcondition. It does not prove that a prior kill/action and ExitStatus can be reliably temporally coupled as one same-raid objective.

genericActionReset.reason: This proof does not generalize Kills.resetOnSessionEnd to visit/place/use-item condition families without their own exact evidence.
